description: Looks up one domain in WHOIS/RDAP and returns whether it is registered, its expiry and registration dates, days until expiry, registrar, status codes and nameservers. Results may be cached for up to 48 hours. Does not need a TLDix account.

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. example.com. A URL or www. prefix is accepted and stripped.

name: lookup_domain
title: Look up a domain
